title: Hino FG and FH Polished Custom Aluminium Bullbar #10
description: FG & FH Hino 4 post hi-tensile polished aluminium Bullbar with I Beam style centre uprights. One piece heavy duty 76mm cross pipes. Contoured main channel with heavy duty steel backing plate. driving light mounts to customer specification. Tow hitch can be fitted as an option. Optional poly-carbonate headlight covers.
